Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.Starring: Nick Lachey, Vanessa LacheyTrailers1m 45sTRAILERSeason 2 Trailer: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On1m 40sTRAILERSeason 1 Trailer: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On1m 55sSeason 3 Trailer: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move OnEpisodesSelect SeasonSeason 1Season 2Season 357m1. The SplitEmotions are high — and sparks fly — as the couples part then embark on the ultimate love challenge. Can they pick a new partner, with real potential?58m2. The ChoiceWill attraction evolve into deeper connection? Selecting a live-in match makes for flirty fun — and hurt feelings. Time for a life-changing choice.41m3. New Bed, New PartnerOne shock follows another as an honest, tearful outburst leaves everyone speechless. Later, the accelerated trial unions kick off with pillow talk.58m4. Girls & Guys Night OutLove may be blossoming, but jealousy gets in the way. We're moving fast, so meet the racer dad. The truth stings as everyone trades notes over drinks.43m5. Pushing BoundariesAfter an evening of strained cocktail hours, couples cuddle — and implode. A forbidden meeting ends with drama as short-term spouses push each other.54m6. The ChangeoverMajor feelings emerge at the changeover. Everyone's back with their original partners, but the transition might be bumpier than anyone ever imagined.38m7. Back to RealityTears tarnish a bachelorette bash. Longtime loves try to listen and hold on to hope. The couples board the party bus to bond, awkwardly, at a winery.55m8. Time to Answer the UltimatumAn all-nighter deals a blow to a fragile relationship. Can bruised feelings be soothed by a temp partner? Family weigh in with love on the line.39m9. Ultimatum DayUltimatum Day arrives. Now the couples must decide whether they'll marry the love they know, reconnect with an attractive alternative — or walk away.52m10. The ReunionWhere are they now?
